subject: Re: IGT status: decision - conditional listing, wall-clock numbers only
body:
All,

Decision for the April 13 memo: IGT enters the blessed optimizer list as a conditional entry - recommended where training-curve predictability matters more than raw throughput (canary training, reproducibility-sensitive evals), not as a general default. All quoted numbers are wall-clock-matched; the ~30% variance reduction at 8% overhead is the honest headline, and the step-matched 40% goes in a footnote with the methodology.

On the late-training spikes: Halima traced them to an lr_decay_step_fraction cell interacting badly with the transport - config-specific, so that cell is excluded with an explicit note and a recommended safe range.

Bao, please register the optimizer-comparison harness with an owner going forward; the true-vs-shifted parameter lesson alone justifies keeping it alive.

Clean, skeptical work - exactly what this portfolio is for.

Ximena
